device.name: Tecan Cavro XCalibur D syringe pump

facts.text: The package controls Tecan Cavro syringe pumps; XCaliburD covers the XCalibur with a distribution valve
A command frame is built as STX, address, sequence byte, command payload, ETX and an XOR checksum
The standard-mode plunger travel is 0 to 3000 encoder steps and 0 to 24000 in microstep mode
A volume in microliters becomes encoder steps as volume * (3000 / syringe_ul) in standard mode
The valve has 9 ports and the syringe 1000 uL by default; both are constructor options
dispense() selects the port and then moves the plunger by minus the volume in steps
A negative relative plunger move dispenses and a positive one extracts
The command buffer status is 0 when empty and 1 when non-empty
The encoder count of the plunger axis is read with ?4
setSpeed takes an OEM speed code from 0 to 40 and SPEED_CODES maps a code to pulses per second
setStartSpeed states 50 to 1000 pulses per second and setTopSpeed 5 to 6000
setCutoffSpeed states 50 to 2700 pulses per second
setSlope accepts a slope code from 1 to 20
Chainable commands are queued in cmd_chain and sent only when executeChain() sends the chain
terminateCmd() sends T as an executable command, which terminates the running command
setMicrostep sends N0 or N1 immediately instead of queueing it
